Cluster PDF font sizes into heading levels and retain bounding boxes

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"application/pdf","uri":"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"pdf_options":{"extract_metadata":true,"hierarchy":{"enabled":true,"include_bbox":true,"k_clusters":6}}}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].pages);
}
```
